concerns.text: FR-010 (fail fast if <50 subjects) and SC-004 (validity of dataset) lack a completed task. Task T015 is marked incomplete, leaving the critical error-handling path and the specific 'Error: Insufficient valid subjects' exit logic unimplemented.

FR-002 requires calculating mean ventral striatum activation magnitude. Task T016b (implementing this aggregation and writing `ventral_striatum_activation.csv`) is marked incomplete, breaking the data flow for US3 correlation analysis.
FR-001 and SC-001 require memory usage <7GB. Task T008 (memory-efficient streaming) and T018 (verification) are marked incomplete, risking failure on the target GitHub Actions runner.

FR-006 mandates exactly 1,000 permutation iterations. Task T030 description uses the vague phrase 'A sufficient number of iterations' instead of specifying 1,000, making the success criterion untestable and the implementation non-deterministic.

FR-008 and SC-005 require measuring the percentage of subjects passing session ID validation. Task T013b (writing `session_validation_metrics.json`) is marked incomplete, leaving the quantitative measurement for SC-005 without a data source.

Edge Cases and FR-004 require handling zero-variance flexibility scores. Task T025 (flagging/excluding) is incomplete, leaving the data alignment logic in T025b unsupported by a verified upstream exclusion mechanism.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and I (Reproducibility) require checksumming and environment isolation. Tasks T001b (.gitignore), T003 (linting), and T009 (credentials) are marked incomplete, violating the plan's Constitution Check gates.
